key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :0:05AA
name: reset_interrupts_then_probe_file
description: Clears pending interrupt requests and disables interrupts, waits through a long countdown, then calls library routines that probe a file and read a size value. It finishes by writing the interrupt enable register with every bit except fifteen set.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :0:062E
name: set_global_byte_full
description: Sets one global byte to 255 and returns.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :0:064A
name: run_handler_and_reenable_interrupts
description: Calls a stored handler routine, then calls a library routine, and writes the interrupt enable register with bit fifteen set to re-enable the saved interrupt bits.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0004
name: allocate_buffers_after_check
description: Calls a check routine and, if it fails, returns an error code. Otherwise it allocates a 12-byte block and a 16000-byte buffer, freeing the first if the second allocation fails, then runs a three-pass setup loop.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0020
name: allocate_buffers_then_setup_loop
description: Allocates a 12-byte block and a 16000-byte buffer, freeing the first if the second allocation fails, then runs a three-pass setup loop. It returns an error code when either allocation fails.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0040
name: allocate_large_buffer_then_setup
description: Allocates a 16000-byte buffer, freeing an earlier block if that allocation fails, then runs a three-pass setup loop.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0072
name: run_three_pass_setup_loop
description: Runs a counted setup loop over three passes, calling helper routines to process each pass and store its result, then returns.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:00F4
name: count_entries_free_on_overflow
description: Loops over entries and counts them. When the count exceeds four it frees the two buffers and returns an error code.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:011E
name: fill_three_entry_table
description: Fills a table of three entries with helper results, repeating reads until a zero result. It returns through a common exit once the table is full.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:015C
name: adjust_three_field_spread
description: Compares three values from a record and selects their minimum and maximum. When the difference is under fifty it adjusts the record's fields.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:01F8
name: release_buffers_by_size_status
description: Chooses a status code by comparing a size value against a threshold of 301, releases the two work buffers, calls a routine and returns the status.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0216
name: release_buffers_with_status
description: Sets a fixed status code, calls a routine, releases the two work buffers and returns the status.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0274
name: release_work_buffers_fail
description: Releases the 16000-byte buffer and the 12-byte block, then returns a fixed failure code.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:02B8
name: scan_sectors_until_flag
description: Repeatedly looks up the base of increasing sector numbers and calls a check routine until it reports a flag of one. It then returns the difference between two sector bases, adjusted by a fixed offset.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:033A
name: read_boot_sector_via_trackdisk
description: Opens trackdisk.device with a temporary standard I/O request, reads one 512-byte sector into an allocated buffer, then turns the drive motor off and releases everything. It returns zero on success and one when the device cannot be opened.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0396
name: read_one_sector_into_buffer
description: Allocates a 512-byte buffer, reads one sector into it with the disk request, turns the drive motor off and frees the buffer. It returns zero.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0406
name: setup_disk_read_registers
description: Copies a 19-byte block of disk parameters into a request structure and sets the drive select bit. It then programs the disk sync word and the DMA and disk control registers for a read.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:04B2
name: set_interrupt_and_disk_bits
description: Sets the interrupt enable and disk control bits from two long arguments, stores a third argument in low memory and calls a routine with the custom chip base.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0512
name: wait_for_disk_status_bits
description: Clears a field, sets a control bit and waits for a status bit in the CIA port to clear. It then sets another control bit, waits for its status bit, and calls a delay routine with 15000.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0560
name: set_disk_bit_and_wait
description: Sets a disk control bit, waits for the matching status bit from the CIA port, then calls a delay routine with 15000 before returning.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:058E
name: delay_then_call_with_request
description: Calls a delay routine with 15000, then calls a routine with a value from the request block.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:05A8
name: seek_disk_track_to_target
description: Moves the drive head from its current track to a target track one step at a time. It selects the side first when the side differs, waits between steps, then records the new position.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:05F6
name: step_head_to_target_track
description: Steps the disk head toward a target track, setting the side and direction bits and waiting between steps. It then records the new track position.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0622
name: step_head_after_settle_delay
description: Sets a control bit and waits briefly before stepping the head toward the target track. It waits again after stepping and then stores the track number.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0666
name: step_head_by_track_difference
description: Sets the step direction bit and steps the head by the difference between two track values. It then waits, and stores the new track.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:069A
name: delay_then_store_track_field
description: Waits through a long delay, stores a value in the request block's track field, and calls a routine with the block.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:06BE
name: update_drive_status_bits
description: Recomputes a status byte from the first byte at the parameter pointer and the second byte shifted left by seven, with the top bit forced on.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0700
name: set_drive_control_bits
description: Sets bits three to six of a shared control byte and leaves the other bits alone.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0718
name: busy_wait_quarter_count
description: Divides its argument by four and calls a routine that many times, serving as a timing loop.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0740
name: set_control_bit_and_delay
description: Sets bit zero of a shared control byte and then waits through a 3000-count delay.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:076C
name: wait_for_disk_ready_timeout
description: Sets a disk register, then polls the disk status for ready for up to a 200000-count timeout. It returns a timeout code when the count runs out and a success code otherwise.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0800
name: scan_records_for_ready_flag
description: Scans records in a list for a set flag bit, clears a field in the first match and returns a status code. It returns a not-found code when no record matches.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:084C
name: set_flag_and_delay_once
description: When a flag byte is clear, sets it, calls a routine twice, then waits through a 500000-count delay.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:085E
name: set_flag_then_long_delay
description: Sets a flag byte in the record to one, calls a routine with the record, then waits through a 500000-count delay.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:088A
name: clear_flag_if_set
description: When the flag byte is set, clears it and calls a routine with the record twice.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:089C
name: clear_flag_and_notify
description: Clears the flag byte in the record and passes the record to a routine twice.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:08BA
name: find_sync_word_sector_start
description: Searches a buffer for the disk sync word and returns the start of the sector header just before it. It returns zero when the sync word is not found.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:08F4
name: return_pointer_minus_six
description: Returns a stack-local pointer value minus six bytes.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0900
name: search_sync_word_forward
description: Steps through words looking for the disk sync word until the buffer end is reached. It returns the sector start before the sync word, or zero when none is found.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:090C
name: write_sector_header_with_sync
description: Writes a sector preamble with two gap words and the disk sync word into a buffer. It then encodes the header fields through helper routines and returns a status code.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0934
name: write_sector_preamble_and_encode
description: Writes a sector preamble with the disk sync word at a computed position, then encodes the header fields through helper routines and returns the resulting status.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:094C
name: write_sector_preamble_then_fields
description: Writes the sector preamble with the disk sync word, encodes the sector fields through helper routines, and stores the resulting bytes and status in the request.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:09FC
name: verify_all_sector_checksums
description: Loops over the eleven sectors of a track, looking up each sector base and checking its header and data. It returns the first error code, or zero when every sector passes.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0A88
name: verify_remaining_sectors
description: Continues the sector check loop from the next sector, comparing each sector's values and returning the first error or zero.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0A90
name: return_stored_status_field
description: Returns the status value stored in a local slot of the frame.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0A98
name: compute_sector_base_address
description: Returns the address of a sector by starting from the track's first sector and adding 1088 bytes for each step toward the requested sector number, wrapping at eleven sectors.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0ACC
name: step_sector_base_until_match
description: Advances a sector base address by 1088 bytes per step, wrapping sector numbers at eleven, until the sector number matches. It returns the address reached.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0B04
name: validate_sector_header_fields
description: Checks a sector's sync word, its two checksum values, and the header's marker, track, sector number and size fields. It returns zero for a valid header and a specific error code for each failed check.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0B1E
name: check_sector_header_fields
description: Performs the same header checks as the sector header validator, comparing the two checksum values and the marker, track, sector and size fields. It returns zero when they all pass.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0B54
name: check_header_fields_only
description: Checks the marker, track, sector number and size fields of a header against the expected track. It returns zero when they match, or an error code for the first failing field.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0B68
name: check_track_sector_size_fields
description: Checks a header's track field against the expected track, then its sector number and size fields. It returns zero when they match or the error code of the first failing check.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0B88
name: check_sector_number_and_size
description: Checks that the sector number is below eleven and that the size byte is in range. It returns zero when both pass, or an error code otherwise.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0B9E
name: check_sector_size_field
description: Checks that the header's size byte is between one and eleven. It returns zero when valid and an error code otherwise.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0BB8
name: return_zero_status
description: Returns zero with no other work.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0BBE
name: compute_mfm_xor_checksum
description: XORs the longwords of a block together and masks the result with the alternate-bit pattern used by the disk encoding. It returns that checksum.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0BEA
name: return_masked_stored_longword
description: Returns a stored longword masked with the alternate-bit pattern used by the disk encoding.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :1:0CF0
name: decode_mfm_longword_pair
description: Decodes an MFM-encoded longword pair by taking the data bits from the second word and the first word shifted left by one. It returns the combined value.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :4:0000
name: create_standard_io_request
description: Creates a message port, stores it in an I/O request, and sets the request's size field to 56 bytes.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :4:0024
name: delete_standard_io_request
description: Deletes the message port attached to an I/O request and frees the 56-byte request block.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :4:0054
name: read_sectors_via_io
description: Sets up a disk read request for a sector offset and a count of 512-byte sectors, then runs it synchronously with the exec I/O call.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :4:009A
name: write_sectors_via_io
description: Sets up a disk write request for a sector offset and a count of 512-byte sectors, then runs it synchronously with the exec I/O call.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :4:00E0
name: format_sectors_via_io
description: Sets up a format request for a sector offset and count, runs two checks through helper routines, and returns one or two if a check fails. Otherwise it runs the request synchronously and returns its result.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :4:012E
name: run_request_after_check
description: Calls a check routine and returns two when it fails. Otherwise it runs the I/O request in the frame synchronously and returns the result.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :4:0144
name: run_io_request
description: Runs the I/O request in the frame synchronously and returns nothing.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :4:0154
name: send_trackdisk_command_four
description: Sets up a request with command code four and zero offset and length, then runs it synchronously.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :4:0182
name: switch_drive_motor_off
description: Sets up a motor request with zero offset and length and runs it synchronously, which switches the drive motor off.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :4:01B0
name: query_disk_status_command
description: Runs a request with the given command code and no offset or length, then returns the status field from the request.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :11:0000
name: allocate_message_port
description: Allocates a signal and a 34-byte port structure, initialises its fields for the current task, and either adds it to the system port list or creates an empty message list. It returns the port, or zero when either allocation fails.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :11:0032
name: allocate_port_body_setup
description: Allocates the port structure, fills its fields from the arguments, and adds it to the port list or sets up an empty list. It frees the signal and returns zero when allocation fails.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :11:0060
name: initialise_port_and_list
description: Fills a port structure's fields for the current task, then either adds it to the port list or initialises an empty message list.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :11:0094
name: initialise_empty_message_list
description: Initialises an empty message list in the port's list field.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :11:00A8
name: delete_message_port
description: Removes a port from the system list if it is linked, marks it as deleted, frees its signal and releases its 34-byte structure.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:           :10:0000
name: initialise_empty_list_header
description: Sets up a list header so its head points to the tail slot and its tail pointers form an empty list.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:c/type:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longwords_and_call
description: If the destination pointer is non-null, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed table into it, then calls a stored routine.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:intro:0:0000
name: program_entry_sets_background_color
description: Program entry of the intro segment. It writes the background colour register and calls four routines; the decompiler produced no pseudo-code for it, so its detail is limited to those facts.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:intro:0:0070
name: store_low_byte_and_shift
description: Stores the low byte of a value from a frame slot into a buffer and returns that value shifted right one bit with the top bit set.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:intro:0:0096
name: shift_bits_out_with_refill
description: Shifts a bit buffer right one bit at a time for the count in d1, reloading the buffer through a helper whenever it becomes zero.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:zany:0:0000
name: allocate_page_aligned_memory_block
description: Rounds a size up to whole 4096-byte pages and requests the block through the exec allocation call, then loops over a stored list of blocks. It is the program entry of the zany segment and calls three further routines.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:zany:0:0050
name: open_dos_and_allocate_memory
description: Opens dos.library through the exec library and makes allocation and supervisor-state calls as listed; the decompiled body is only a return, so the detail is limited to those calls.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:zany:0:0140
name: close_library_and_cleanup
description: Stores the argument into a global, calls a routine through a pointer, then closes a library through the exec library and calls one more routine.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:zany:0:018C
name: patch_library_vector_and_close
description: Opens intuition.library through the exec library, saves one of its function vector entries and points that entry at a local routine. It then closes the library.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:zany:0:01C2
name: conditional_xor_block_with_key
description: If a one-time flag is set, clears it and XORs 270 longwords of a global block with a fixed 32-bit key. It returns the register value unchanged.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:zany:0:01EC
name: xor_block_and_set_flag
description: If the flag is clear, sets it and XORs the same 270-longword block with the key. Together with its counterpart, this toggles the block between two states.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:zany:0:020A
name: suppress_requesters_and_open_dos
description: Saves the current task's window pointer, sets it to minus one to suppress system requesters, and opens dos.library with interrupts disabled around the call.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:zany:0:0258
name: open_intuition_library_checked
description: Opens intuition.library with interrupts disabled around the call, sets an error marker if the library is missing, and restores the task's window pointer saved by the caller.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:zany:0:02E0
name: clear_block_with_interrupts_off
description: Disables interrupts, clears a 2048-byte block of memory byte by byte, and restores the interrupt state through library calls.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:zany:0:031A
name: call_library_with_interrupts_off
description: Disables interrupts, calls a library routine, and re-enables interrupts.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:zany:0:0336
name: extract_next_token_from_line
description: Scans a line of text, skipping spaces and semicolon comments, and copies the next token into a buffer. Quoted tokens are copied without their quotes, and the buffer is zero-terminated.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:zany:0:034E
name: copy_token_to_buffer
description: Copies the next token from a text pointer into an output buffer, either the text inside quotes or characters up to a space or newline. It skips semicolon comments and zero-terminates the output.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h nnt]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h NNT].adf:zany:0:037A
name: skip_comments_and_copy_token
description: Skips spaces, line ends and semicolon comments to reach the next token, then copies that token into the output buffer, quoted or unquoted.
